note:
Charge-SR with a 'Seven Dwarves' auto-fire that piggybacks every full-charge shot, plus a burst 'Seven Dwarves Fully Active' mode (2 uses). Board: 0.954 COLD on 4 graded comps (0.91 / 0.94 / 0.96 / 1.00). Every damage coefficient below is a datamined kit literal — do not shave one to close a residual. Kit-faithfulness is pinned test-first in scripts/tests/units/snow-white-heavy-arms.test.ts (31 pins).
S1. (a) passive enemy damageTakenPct 4.2 — the kit grants it every 0.2s while charging to Lock-On targets for 4s; she charges continuously against the single boss, so a permanent passive is exact here and the Lock-On targeting itself is inert (one target). (b) fullCharge, ungated: 41.9% AoE + 527.95% sequential — the baseline volley, 105.59% x the 5 ammo Auto Fire Ready loads. (c) fullCharge, swapGate:'swapped': +1055.9% sequential. This is the EXTRA over baseline, not the whole Fully-Active volley: Fully Active raises loaded ammo to 15, so the volley is 105.59 x 15 = 1583.85%, and (b) already deals 527.95 of it in every state. It rides ONLY her two swapped full-charge shots inside the FB window. COMMUNITY twice-confirmed: gamewith JP holds the Fully Active buffs per fully-charged shot (1発間維持), prydwen documents the 7 -> 15-hit structure.
S2. (a) battleStart chargeTimeClamp 1.2 = 'Fixes charge time at 1.2 sec'. Her datamined base charge is already 1.2s, so the live effect of the clamp is to block ally Charge Speed buffs from speeding her below the kit's fixed cadence; while swapped, the Fully-Active window's own 3.2s clamp shadows it. (b) fullCharge: atkPct 46.84 / partsDamagePct 62.64 / gainPierce, all 5s. Parts damage is inert vs the partless boss but kept for fidelity; gainPierce is inert in comps with no pierceDamagePct source and live e.g. under zwei's team Pierce Damage. (c) stageEnter 3: atkPct 73.92, 10s. (d) burstCast: chargeDamagePct 528 + sequentialDamagePct 158.4, both durationShots 2 — kit-literal 'for 1 round(s)' across the 2 Fully-Active uses, covering exactly the two swap rounds with crit/core intact. PRYDWEN-CONFIRMED (quoted): 'Sequential attack damage ▲158.4%' is an ATK DMG (damage-up bucket) buff, 'diluted by ... other support buffs' — so it is modeled as an additive sequentialDamagePct that applies ONLY to sequential-flavored hits (the 527.95 and 1055.9 riders) and dilutes at deal time against live Attack Damage buffs. The engine routes it through dealDamage's sequential gate into the damage-up bucket — NOT through sequentialMultPct, which is eve's separate multiplicative mechanic. '528% Charge Damage (making it 778%)' confirms charge points are additive.
BURST. (a) self attackDamagePct 84.48, 10s. (b) weaponSwap: the same 69.04% shot, chargeTimeClamp 3.2, durationSec 10, maxShots 2 — ~6.5s of 3.2s rounds is exactly 2 shots. Modeling Fully Active as a swap rather than a cast-instant lump is what keeps the volley on the shots: it crits per-shot like her baseline procs, and a swap shot lost to the window loses its volley with it.
CADENCE: she is a release-fired SR (datamined input_type 'UP'), so she takes the standard +22f bolt recovery like every other 'UP' SR, and her base charge is the datamined 72f (charge_time 120cs). Her Fully-Active swap keeps its own 3.2s-fixed cadence, unaffected.
UNMODELED / inert: DEF ▲ 42.24% (defensive, no HP pool); Lock-On targeting and the Max-Lock-On / max-ammo caps beyond the ammo counts used above (single boss); parts-damage buckets (partless boss); Fully-Active use-count bookkeeping and its normal-attack removal condition (the sim always full-charges); the burst's 41.9% to destructible projectiles (none vs a single boss).
OPEN: (a) whether the Fully-Active volley is delivered by USES or by TIME — the two agree at the current 3.2s cadence and diverge only if a shot is displaced; the sim delivers by uses. ⇒ open-questions U39. (b) W14: stageEnter:3 and burstCast are not behaviorally discriminable for her in a sole-B3 fixture, since they coincide. Per-sub-hit burst-gauge credit: the S1(b) 527.95% sequential volley carries gaugeHits:5 (5 loaded ammo) and the S1(c) 1055.9% EXTRA volley carries gaugeHits:10 (the 15−5 extra ammo); measured 2026-08-15 (swha-solo.mov). The S1(c) block is gauge-inert in practice because it fires only inside the FB/chain lock, but it is authored for fidelity.

skill1: Lock-On — Function: Designates the enemy as a target of Seven Dwarves. Max Lock-On targets: 5. Deactivation condition: Performing a normal attack or taking cover.
Auto Fire Ready — Effect: DEF ▲ 42.24% continuously.
Auto Fire Ready — Function: Loads Seven Dwarves with ammo. Max ammo loaded by Auto Fire Ready: 5. Deactivation condition: Performing a normal attack.
■ Activates when performing a normal attack while not in Full Burst. Affects self. Removes Seven Dwarves Fully Active.
burst: Seven Dwarves Fully Active — Function: Increases max number of Lock-On targets and max ammo loaded by Auto Fire Ready, but also increases Charge Time.
■ Affects all destructible projectiles. Deals 41.9% of final ATK as damage.
